concepts.gloss_en: the speaking one; the articulate/human element (of the four: inanimate-plant-animal-speaker)

reason_for_human: These are two different words sharing the consonantal form מדבר. Occurrence 1 is מְדַבֵּר ('speaker,' the human element in חי מדבר / animal-and-human), while occurrence 2 quotes וּמִמִּדְבָּר מַתָּנָה (Num 21:18), which is מִדְבָּר ('wilderness'). Clear homograph split — keep them as distinct concepts.
